tool.name: Membrane Builder
tool.description: Embed a protein into a lipid membrane using
tool.command:
ln -s $pdb_file inputfile.pdb &&
packmol-memgen --pdb inputfile.pdb $input_preoriented $input_keepligs #if $ligand_options.advance == 'yes' --keepligs #end if --nloop $input_nloop --nloop_all $input_nloop_all --writeout $input_writeout $input_random --tolerance $input_tolerance --prot_rad $input_prot_rad
#if $second_lipid_options.advance == 'advance' --lipids $input_lipids_1:$second_lipid_options.input_lipids_2 --ratio $second_lipid_options.input_ratio #else
--lipids $input_lipids_1 --ratio 1
#end if
#if $box_dimention_advance_option.advance == 'advance' --dims $box_dimention_advance_option.input_dims_x $box_dimention_advance_option.input_dims_y $box_dimention_advance_option.input_dims_z #end if
#if $salt_options.salt == 'add'
--salt
#if $salt_options.input_salt_c != '' --salt_c $salt_options.input_salt_c #end if
#if $salt_options.input_salt_a != '' --salt_a $salt_options.input_salt_a #end if
$salt_options.salt_override_option $salt_options.option_nocounter
#if $salt_options.salt_conc_option.advance == 'advance': --saltcon $salt_options.salt_conc_option.input_saltcon #end if #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.advance == 'advance'
#if $all_the_advance_options.MEMEMBED_options.advance == 'advance' $all_the_advance_options.MEMEMBED_options.input_barrel
#if $all_the_advance_options.MEMEMBED_options.input_n_ter != '' --n_ter $all_the_advance_options.MEMEMBED_options.input_n_ter #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.MEMEMBED_options.input_mem_opt != '' --mem_opt $all_the_advance_options.MEMEMBED_options.input_mem_opt #end if #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.PACKMOL_options.advance == 'advance' $all_the_advance_options.PACKMOL_options.input_notrun $all_the_advance_options.PACKMOL_options.input_packall $all_the_advance_options.PACKMOL_options.input_movebadrandom #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.Computational_electrophysiology.advance == 'advance' $all_the_advance_options.Computational_electrophysiology.input_double #if $all_the_advance_options.Computational_electrophysiology.input_charge_imbalance != '' --charge_imbalance $all_the_advance_options.Computational_electrophysiology.input_charge_imbalance #end if --imbalance_ion $all_the_advance_options.Computational_electrophysiology.input_imbalance_ion #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.advance == 'advance' #if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_distxy_fix != '' --distxy_fix $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_distxy_fix #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_noxy_cen != '' --noxy_cen $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_noxy_cen #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_channel_plug != '' --channel_plug $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_channel_plug #end if
$all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_self_assembly
#if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.advance_curved_2d_gaussian.advance == 'advance' --xygauss $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.advance_curved_2d_gaussian.input_xygauss_x $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.advance_curved_2d_gaussian.input_xygauss_y $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.advance_curved_2d_gaussian.input_xygauss_h #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_curvature != '' --curvature $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_curvature #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_curv_radius != '' --curv_radius $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_curv_radius #end if
$all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_vol
#if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.Computational_solvate_system.advance == '--solvate' --solvate $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.Computational_solvate_system.input_cubic #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_leaflet != '' --leaflet $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_leaflet #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_lip_offset != '' --lip_offset $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_lip_offset #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_apl_offset != '' --apl_offset $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_apl_offset #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_tailplane != '' --tailplane $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_tailplane #end if
#if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_headplane != '' --headplane $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_headplane #end if
$all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_notgridvol
$all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_reducebuild $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_keep $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_noprogress $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_apl_exp
$all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_charmm $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.input_sirah
#if $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.translate_protein_orient_option.advance == 'advance' --translate $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.translate_protein_orient_option.input_translate_x $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.translate_protein_orient_option.input_translate_y $all_the_advance_options.others_parameters.translate_protein_orient_option.input_translate_z #end if #end if #end if
--dist $input_dist --dist_wat $input_dist_wat
#if $input_distxy_fix: --distxy_fix $input_distxy_fix #end if
$input_notprotonate $input_nottrim
--output "out.pdb" --log $log_file
#if $remove_cavity_lipids && python '$__tool_directory__/remove_cavity_lipids.py' out.pdb out_cleaned.pdb && mv out_cleaned.pdb out.pdb #end if
#if $output_option == 'true' and $ligand_options.advance == 'yes' && python '$__tool_directory__/separate.py' --input-file "out.pdb" -l $ligand_options.ligand_name --output-ligand ligand.pdb #end if
##python conf.py --lipids "DOPC,DOPA,AOPC" --ligand LIG -c "NA+" -a "CL-" -o config.txt && python '$__tool_directory__/conf.py'
#if $second_lipid_options.advance == 'advance' --lipids $input_lipids_1,$second_lipid_options.input_lipids_2 #elif $second_lipid_options.advance == 'simple' --lipids $input_lipids_1 #end if
#if $ligand_options.advance == 'yes' --ligand $ligand_options.ligand_name #end if
#if $salt_options.salt == 'add' #if $salt_options.input_salt_c != '' --ions $salt_options.input_salt_c,Cl- #end if #if $salt_options.input_salt_a != '' --ions $salt_options.input_salt_c,$salt_options.input_salt_a #end if #end if
--output $conf_out

param.name: pdb_file
param.label: Input PDB file
param.help: Select the PDB file of the protein to embed in the membrane.

param.name: input_lipids_1
param.label: Primary lipid type
param.help: Choose the main lipid molecule for membrane construction.

param.name: advance
param.label: Add a second lipid type?
param.help: Select 'Yes' to add a second lipid type to the membrane.
param.option: No, use only one lipid type
Yes, add a second lipid type

param.name: input_lipids_2
param.label: Secondary lipid type
param.help: Choose the second lipid molecule for membrane construction (for mixtures).

param.name: input_ratio
param.label: Lipid mixture ratio
param.help: Enter the ratio for the two lipid types (e.g., 9:1 for 90% LIP1, 10% LIP2).

param.name: advance
param.label: Does the file contain a ligand?
param.help: Select 'Yes' to separate ligands from the protein after embedding.

param.name: ligand_name
param.label: Ligand residue name
param.help: Enter the three-letter residue name of the ligand to be separated (e.g., DRG for drug).

param.name: salt
param.label: Salt option
param.help: Choose whether to add salt to the system.

param.name: input_salt_c
param.label: Cation type
param.help: Cation to add (K+, Na+, Ca2+, Mg2+). Default is K+.

param.name: input_salt_a
param.label: Anion type
param.help: Anion to add. Default is Cl-.

param.name: advance
param.label: Salt concentration option
param.help: Choose to use the default or specify a custom salt concentration.

param.name: input_saltcon
param.label: Salt concentration (M)
param.help: Specify the salt concentration in molar (M). Overrides the default KCl value.

param.name: salt_override_option
param.label: Override salt warning
param.help: Continue even if the salt concentration is less than required for neutralization.

param.name: option_nocounter
param.label: No counterions
param.help: Do not add counterions. Relies on pmemd 'plasma' neutralization.

param.name: input_preoriented
param.label: Do you need to orient the protein during the embedding process?
param.help: Leave this off if the protein has been previosuly oriented and you want to avoid running MEMEMBED (i.e. if your protein was obtained from a database like OPM, you may not need to do this)

param.name: input_dist
param.label: Minimum distance to box boundaries (Å)
param.help: Set the minimum distance between the protein and the box boundaries in x, y, and z. Default: 15 Å. The actual distance may be larger in some cases.

param.name: input_distxy_fix
param.label: Membrane lengths along XY plane edges (Å)
param.help: Set the distance along the XY plane edges of the membrane. Use 80-90 (small), 110-140 (moderate), 150-180 (large) for desired membrane size.

param.name: input_dist_wat
param.label: Water layer width (z axis, Å)
param.help: Set the width of the water layer above the membrane or protein along the z axis. Default: 17.5 Å.

param.name: input_notprotonate
param.label: Skip protonation
param.help: Do not perform protonation using Reduce.

param.name: input_nottrim
param.label: Keep existing hydrogens
param.help: Do not trim preexisting hydrogens in the structure.

param.name: input_keepligs
param.label: Keep ligands from original PDB
param.help: Keep ligands present in the original PDB file. By default, ligands are removed.

param.name: input_random
param.label: Enable PACKMOL random seed
param.help: Enable PACKMOL random seed generator. If previous packing failed, enabling this may help solve minimization issues.

param.name: input_nloop
param.label: Number of nloops for GENCAN routine in PACKMOL
param.help: number of nloops for GENCAN routine in PACKMOL. PACKMOL MEMGEN uses 20 by default; you might consider increasing the number to improve packing. Increasing the number of components requires more GENCAN loops.

param.name: input_nloop_all
param.label: Number of nloops for all-together packing.
param.help: NLOOP_ALL number of nloops for all-together packing. PACKMOL MEMGEN uses 100 by default.

param.name: input_writeout
param.label: Frequency for writing intermediate results.
param.help: WRITEOUT frequency for writing intermediate results. PACKMOL uses 10 by default.

param.name: input_tolerance
param.label: Tolerance for detecting clashes between molecules in PACKMOL
param.help: TOLERANCE tolerance for detecting clashes between molecules in PACKMOL (defined as radius1+radius2). PACKMOL uses 2.0 by default.

param.name: input_prot_rad
param.label: Radius for detecting clashes
param.help: PROT_RAD radius considered for protein atoms to establish the tolerance for detecting clashes. PACKMOL MEMGEN uses 1.5 by default.

param.name: input_dims_x
param.label: Box dimensions vector for the x axes.
param.help: X box dimensions vector for the x axes. Be sure to use dimensions that cover the complete protein to be packed!!

param.name: input_dims_y
param.label: Box dimensions vector for the y axes.
param.help: Y box dimensions vector for the y axes. Be sure to use dimensions that cover the complete protein to be packed!!

param.name: input_dims_z
param.label: Box dimensions vector for the z axes.
param.help: Z box dimensions vector for the z axes. Be sure to use dimensions that cover the complete protein to be packed!!

param.name: advance
param.label: Advanced options
param.help: Choose 'Advanced options' to customize additional simulation parameters. Default is 'System defaults'.

param.name: advance
param.label: MEMEMBED advanced options
param.help: Select 'Yes' to configure MEMEMBED-specific parameters. Default uses program settings.

param.name: input_barrel
param.label: Enable beta barrel mode
param.help: Use MEMEMBED in beta barrel mode.

param.name: input_n_ter
param.label: --n_ter
param.help: 'in' or 'out'. By default proteins are oriented with the n_ter oriented 'in' (or 'down'). relevant for multi layer system. If defined for one protein, it has to be defined for all of them, following previous order

param.name: input_mem_opt
param.label: --mem_opt
param.help: 'in' or 'out'. By default proteins are oriented with the n_ter oriented 'in' (or 'down'). relevant for multi layer system. If defined for one protein, it has to be defined for all of them, following previous order

param.name: advance
param.label: PACKMOL advanced options
param.help: Select 'Yes' to configure PACKMOL-specific parameters. Default uses program settings.

param.name: input_notrun
param.label: Skip PACKMOL execution
param.help: Do not run PACKMOL, even if available.

param.name: input_packall
param.label: Skip initial individual packing steps
param.help: Skip initial individual packing steps.

param.name: input_movebadrandom
param.label: Randomize badly placed molecules
param.help: Randomize positions of badly placed molecules in the initial guess.

param.name: advance
param.label: Computational electrophysiology advanced options
param.help: Select 'Yes' to configure computational electrophysiology parameters. Default uses program settings.

param.name: input_double
param.label: Enable double bilayer system (CompEL)
param.help: Assume a stacked double bilayer system for CompEL. The --lipids composition will be used for both bilayers, flipping the leaflets.

param.name: input_charge_imbalance
param.label: Charge imbalance between compartments
param.help: Set a charge imbalance between compartments (in electron charge units). Positive values increase cations (or decrease anions) in the central compartment.

param.name: input_imbalance_ion
param.label: Ion type for charge imbalance
param.help: Select whether cations or anions are used to imbalance the system charges. Default is 'Cations'.

param.name: advance
param.label: Other advanced options
param.help: Select 'Yes' to configure additional advanced parameters. Default uses program settings.
param.option: Yes, show all other advanced parameters

param.name: input_distxy_fix
param.label: Specify the membrane patch side length in the x and y axis.
param.help: DISTXY_FIX specify the membrane patch side length in the x and y axis. Useful when only lipids are packed! By default is calculated flexibly depending on the protein

param.name: input_noxy_cen
param.label: Disable default centering in the xy plane
param.help: disable default centering in the xy plane that ensures symmetric membrane building. Not recommended!

param.name: input_channel_plug
param.label: Establishes a cylindrical restraint on the lipids using the protein z height and the input value as xy radius.
param.help: CHANNEL_PLUG establishes a cylindrical restraint on the lipids using the protein z height and the input value as xy radius. A value of 0 will use half of the protein radius. By default, no restraint is imposed.

param.name: input_self_assembly
param.label: Places lipids all over the packed box, and not in a bilayer.
param.help: places lipids all over the packed box, and not in a bilayer.

param.name: advance
param.label: Set parameters for a curved 2d gaussian in the xy plane.

param.name: input_xygauss_x
param.label: uncertainty in x
param.help: C set parameters for a curved 2d gaussian in the xy plane. Parameters are uncertainty in x.

param.name: input_xygauss_y
param.label: uncertainty in y
param.help: D set parameters for a curved 2d gaussian in the y plane. Parameters are uncertainty in y.

param.name: input_xygauss_h
param.label: gaussian height
param.help: H set parameters for a curved 2d gaussian gaussian height. By default, membranes are flat.

param.name: input_curvature
param.label: Set the curvature of the membrane patch. By default, membranes are flat.
param.help: CURVATURE set the curvature of the membrane patch. By default, membranes are flat.

param.name: input_curv_radius
param.label: Inverse of curvature. Set the curvature as if on a vesicle with the provided radius.
param.help: CURV_RADIUS inverse of curvature. Set the curvature as if on a vesicle with the provided radius.

param.name: advance
param.label: Solvate the system without adding lipids.
Cube shaped box. Only works with
param.name: input_cubic
param.help: Cube shaped box. Only works with --solvate

param.name: input_vol
param.label: Do the lipid number estimation based on the volume occupied by the leaflet instead of APL
param.help: do the lipid number estimation based on the volume occupied by the leaflet instead of APL. This might cause a great overestimation of the number of lipid molecules!

param.name: input_leaflet
param.label: Set desired leaflet width.
param.help: LEAFLET set desired leaflet width. 23 by default.

param.name: input_lip_offset
param.label: Factor that multiplies the x/y sizes for the lipid membrane segment.
param.help: LIP_OFFSET factor that multiplies the x/y sizes for the lipid membrane segment. Might improve packing and handling by AMBER

param.name: input_apl_offset
param.label: Factor that multiplies the default APL values.
param.help: APL_OFFSET factor that multiplies the default APL values. Helpful if packing stretched membranes.

param.name: input_tailplane
param.label: Sets the position BELOW which the CH3 carbon atoms in the tail should be.
param.help: TAILPLANE sets the position BELOW which the CH3 carbon atoms in the tail should be. By default defined in parameter file.

param.name: input_headplane
param.label: Sets the position ABOVE which the PO4 phosphorus and N atoms in the polar head group should be
param.help: HEADPLANE sets the position ABOVE which the PO4 phosphorus and N atoms in the polar head group should be.By default defined in parameter file

param.name: input_notgridvol
param.label: Skips grid building for volume estimation
param.help: skips grid building for volume estimation, and the calculation is done just by estimating density

param.name: input_reducebuild
param.label: Build step by reduce (protonation of His and side-chain flips).
param.help: build step by reduce (protonation of His and side-chain flips). Use with care if parametrizing with the script!

param.name: input_keep
param.label: Skips deleting temporary files.
param.help: skips deleting temporary files

param.name: input_noprogress
param.label: Avoids the printing of progress bar with time estimation in the final stage.
param.help: avoids the printing of progress bar with time estimation in the final stage. Recommended if the job is piped into a file

param.name: input_apl_exp
param.label: Use experimental APL
param.help: use experimental APL where available, like AmberTools18 release. Kept for consistency with older versions. By default, terms estimated with Lipid17 are used

param.name: input_charmm
param.label: The output will be in CHARMM format instead of AMBER.
param.help: the output will be in CHARMM format instead of AMBER. Works only for small subset of lipids (see --available_lipids)

param.name: advance
param.label: Pass a vector as x y z to translate the oriented pdb

param.name: input_translate_x
param.label: --translate
param.help: TRANSLATE TRANSLATE TRANSLATE pass a vector as x to translate the oriented pdb. Ex. 10

param.name: input_translate_y
param.label: --translate
param.help: TRANSLATE TRANSLATE TRANSLATE pass a vector as y to translate the oriented pdb. Ex. 4

param.name: input_translate_z
param.label: --translate
param.help: TRANSLATE TRANSLATE TRANSLATE pass a vector as z to translate the oriented pdb. Ex. 14

param.name: input_sirah
param.label: Use SIRAH lipids, and corase-grain protein input.
param.help: use SIRAH lipids, and corase-grain protein input. Will adapt tolerance accordingly. Only small subset of lipids available!

param.name: output_option
param.label: Generates additional Ligand file
param.help: Make sure that you have selected correction option for 'Does the file contain a ligand?' parameter and entered a valid ligand name. for the 'Ligand residue name' parameter.

param.name: remove_cavity_lipids
param.label: Remove misplaced lipids from protein cavity
param.help: Automatically detect and remove lipids that packmol-memgen incorrectly placed inside beta barrel or ion channel cavities.

tool.help:
.. class:: infomark
**What it does**
Membrane Builder embeds proteins into lipid bilayer membranes for molecular dynamics (MD) simulations. This tool automates the complex process of building membrane-protein systems with customizable lipid compositions, salt concentrations, and simulation box parameters using the PACKMOL-Memgen backend.
It is designed for high-throughput studies of membrane proteins such as GPCRs, ion channels, transporters, and other membrane-embedded proteins. The tool supports single and mixed lipid compositions, automatic system neutralization with ions, and optional advanced features for computational electrophysiology and coarse-grain simulations.
-----
**Key Features**
- **Automated protein embedding** into lipid bilayers with PACKMOL - **Mixed lipid membranes** with custom composition ratios (e.g., POPC:CHL1 at 9:1) - **Ion addition** with customizable cation/anion types and concentrations - **Ligand handling** and separation from protein structures - **Beta barrel protein support** via MEMEMBED orientation mode - **Curved membrane generation** with Gaussian height profiles - **Computational electrophysiology** (CompEL) double bilayer systems - **CHARMM and SIRAH** coarse-grain format support - **Automatic cavity lipid detection** for ion channels and beta barrels
-----
**Inputs**
- **Input PDB file** *(required)*: Protein structure file in PDB format to embed in the membrane.
- **Primary lipid type** *(required)*: Main lipid molecule for membrane construction. Options include: - DPPC (1,2-dipalmitoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine) - POPC (1-palmitoyl-2-oleoyl-sn-glycero-3-phosphocholine) - CHL1 (cholesterol) - DAPC, PAPC, PAPG, and others
- **Secondary lipid type** *(optional)*: Second lipid for mixed membranes with specified molar ratio (e.g., 9:1, 7:3).
- **Ligand residue name** *(optional)*: Three-letter residue code (e.g., DRG) to separate from the system after embedding.
- **Salt options** *(optional)*: - Salt type: No salt, or add custom cation/anion pairs (Na+, K+, Ca2+, Cl-, etc.) - Concentration: Custom molar concentration (e.g., 0.15M) or default physiological
-----
**Outputs**
- **System (PDB)**: Complete membrane-protein system with lipids, water, and ions in AMBER format. - **Ligand (PDB)** *(optional)*: Separated ligand structure if ligand extraction is enabled. - **Log file**: PACKMOL-Memgen execution log with packing details and diagnostics. - **Configuration file (conf_out)**: Component definitions for downstream GROMACS MD index generation.
**Advanced Options**
*MEMEMBED Options* Configure protein orientation and membrane embedding:
- Beta barrel mode for outer membrane proteins - N-terminus orientation (inward/outward) - Optimization method (Direct, Grid, Genetic Algorithm)
*PACKMOL Options* Fine-tune molecular packing behavior:
- Skip PACKMOL execution (notrun) - Skip initial individual packing (packall) - Randomize badly placed molecules (movebadrandom)
*Computational Electrophysiology* Double bilayer systems for ion channel simulations:
- Enable double bilayer mode - Set charge imbalance between compartments - Select ion type for charge compensation
*Membrane Geometry* Customize membrane structure and shape:
- Fixed XY membrane dimensions (distxy_fix) - Curved membranes with Gaussian height profiles - Membrane curvature radius for vesicles - Leaflet width and APL offset parameters
*Other Advanced Parameters* System customization options:
- Enable/disable system solvation - Set translation vectors for protein positioning - Toggle progress reporting and temporary file cleanup - Specify CHARMM or SIRAH force field output
-----
**Tips and Best Practices**
- **Pre-oriented proteins**: If your protein is already oriented (e.g., from OPM database), disable "Orient protein during embedding" to skip MEMEMBED.
- **Failed packing**: If packing fails, try enabling the random seed option, increasing PACKMOL nloop values, or increasing membrane dimensions with distxy_fix parameter.
- **Ion channels and beta barrels**: Use the "Remove misplaced lipids" option to automatically detect and remove lipids incorrectly placed inside cavities.
- **Large systems**: Increase PACKMOL nloop values (default 20) for systems with many lipids or complex protein geometries.
- **Computational efficiency**: Use "Skip PACKMOL execution" option if you only want the system setup without molecular packing.
- **Force field compatibility**: Select appropriate output format (CHARMM, SIRAH) if not using AMBER force fields.
-----
**References**
- **PACKMOL-Memgen**: Schott-Verdugo S, Gohlke H. *PACKMOL-Memgen: A Python Wrapper for Packmol to Build Molecular Systems*. J Chem Inf Model. 2019;59(6):2522-2528. doi:10.1021/acs.jcim.9b00066
- **AmberTools**: Case DA, et al. *AmberTools Reference Manual*. 2023. University of California, San Francisco.
- **MEMEMBED**: Nugent T, Jones DT. *Transmembrane protein topology prediction using support vector machines*. BMC Bioinformatics. 2013;14:276. doi:10.1186/1471-2105-14-276
- **GROMACS**: Abraham MJ, et al. *GROMACS: High performance molecular simulations through multi-level parallelism from laptops to supercomputers*. SoftwareX. 2015;1-2:19-25. doi:10.1016/j.softx.2015.06.001
